summary.title: Bethe logarithm from the model's own hydrogen spectrum
summary.verdict: ln k0 derived from the model Coulomb resolvent (no literature constant), reproducing 2.984/2.812/-0.030 to ~2-3%; the model-Bethe Lamb shift lands within ~1% of measured.

lamb.statement: one-loop radiative shift lifts the exact Dirac 2s-2p degeneracy to ~1052 MHz ~ 99.5% of the measured 1057.845 MHz; Uehling (-27.1 MHz) derived from F251, self-energy from the Bethe log (model-derived (F257 Dalgarno-Lewis)). Residual ~5.6 MHz is higher-order alpha(Z alpha)^5/two-loop QED, out of leading-order scope.

B1_ln_k0_1s.quantity: Bethe log ln k0(1s) from model Coulomb resolvent

B2_ln_k0_2s.quantity: Bethe log ln k0(2s) from model Coulomb resolvent

B4_lamb_model_bethe.quantity: Lamb shift with model-derived Bethe log (no literature)
